exact_TimePeriod_syntax:
[Controls]

  [./*]

    [./<types>]

      [./<TimePeriod>]
        # "Control the enabled/disabled state of objects with time."
        control_tags     = (no_default)           # "Adds user-defined labels for accessing object parameters
                                                  # via control logic."
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: "Advanced"
        depends_on       = (no_default)           # "The Controls that this control relies upon (i.e. must
                                                  # execute before this one)"
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
        disable_objects  = (no_default)           # "A list of object tags to disable."
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
        enable           = 1                      # "Set the enabled status of the MooseObject."
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: "Advanced"
        enable_objects   = (no_default)           # "A list of object tags to enable."
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
        end_time         = (no_default)           # "The time at which the objects are to be enable/disabled."
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
        execute_on       = 'INITIAL TIMESTEP_END' # "The list of flag(s) indicating when this object should
                                                  # be executed. For a description of each flag, see https://mooseframework.inl.gov/source/interfaces/SetupInterface.html."
                                                  # Options: XFEM_MARK, FORWARD, ADJOINT, HOMOGENEOUS_FORWARD,
                                                  # ADJOINT_TIMESTEP_BEGIN, ADJOINT_TIMESTEP_END, NONE,
                                                  # INITIAL, LINEAR, LINEAR_CONVERGENCE, NONLINEAR, NONLINEAR_CONVERGENCE,
                                                  # POSTCHECK, TIMESTEP_END, TIMESTEP_BEGIN, MULTIAPP_FIXED_POINT_END,
                                                  # MULTIAPP_FIXED_POINT_BEGIN, MULTIAPP_FIXED_POINT_CONVERGENCE,
                                                  # MULTISYSTEM_FIXED_POINT_ITERATION_END, FINAL, CUSTOM,
                                                  # PRE_MULTIAPP_SETUP
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
        implicit         = 1                      # "Determines whether this object is calculated using
                                                  # an implicit or explicit form"
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: "Advanced"
        reverse_on_false = 1                      # "When true, the disable/enable lists are set to opposite
                                                  # values when the specified condition is false."
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
        set_sync_times   = 0                      # "Set the start and end time as execute sync times."
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
        start_time       = (no_default)           # "The time at which the objects are to be enabled/disabled."
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
        type             = TimePeriod             # ""
                                                  # Unit: ""
                                                  # Group: ""
      [../]
    [../]
  [../]
[]
